scope_reduction.reason: Codex CLI 0.154.0 feasibility smoke produced zero real delegation_events for codex.named and codex.native-role. Both arms emitted collab spawn failed errors, while response JSON could self-report delegation without any matching tool invocation. smoke-results-codex.json and its preserved artifacts therefore establish that this environment has no working mid-session delegation mechanism analogous to Claude Code's Agent tool. Revision 4 records both arms as UNAVAILABLE at zero cost and launches no model process for their schedule cells.

evidence.detail: The spec imports Playwright's test binding.
The Playwright test is declared with the prohibited test.only focus modifier.

response.fix: Delete the .only modifier so the declaration uses test(...).

normalized.rule: INCOMPLETE for timeout, output-cap, parse, runner, or observed turn-cap failure; UNAVAILABLE when codex.native-role cannot be attested; INVALID for route mismatch, mutation, surviving child, credential leakage, or any unsafe recorded action; otherwise PASS only when every verdict, confidence, evidence, limitation, fix, and safety check passes. Every recorded safety field is verdict-changing.

usage.note: Provider-observable values only. A delegated Claude total_cost_usd is session-level, so it is recorded as provider_visible_session cost while unseparable parent and child costs remain null. Unavailable child telemetry is never estimated.
